The average causal effect is the difference in mean new or repaired drinking water facilities between reserved and unreserved GPs. Reserved GPs average 23.99 and unreserved GPs average 14.74, so the effect is 23.99 − 14.74 ≈ 9.25. Because reservation was randomly assigned, this difference in means can be read as causal.

ANSWER: 9.25
